references.text: Mark 12:30 quotes directly from Deuteronomy 6:5, which is part of the Shema, a central Jewish prayer, and emphasizes the command to love God with all one's being.
Although Hosea 3:6 is not a direct cross-reference, it reflects the theme of loving God as a fundamental obligation throughout Scripture.
Matthew 22:37 repeats the same command found in Mark 12:30, demonstrating its significance in the Synoptic Gospels.
Luke 10:27 also includes this command, showing its universal relevance to Jesus' teaching.
Although Psalm 31:30 is not a direct cross-reference, it reflects the idea of trusting in God with all one's heart, which resonates with the command to love God completely.
